$comment: Playoff brackets RECONSTRUCTED from schedule.json for AFL seasons whose MFL playoffBracket export carries seeds only (no franchise ids, no points). Generated by scripts/reconstruct-afl-playoff-brackets.mjs — advisory, not MFL's own record. Never written into mfl-feeds/. Shape mirrors the `brackets` map in playoff-brackets.json so the existing renderer consumes it unchanged.
